dogecoin.text: Here's a thorough overview of Elon Musk's performance on Saturday Night Live, last night, if you didn't watch it. Sounds rough!! It's interesting to read the lamentation this morning on social media with Dogecoin losing almost 30% in value & Robinhood crashing during the episode.
Very troubling article for the crypto space. And Dogecoin seems to be following BTC down over the last several days.

@abcampbell How much ephemeral wealth will be lost in a few months? Probably a lot. I guess we will re-do the 2021 Dogecoin experience every 3 years. 3 years must be the current financial memory for US retail traders.
